indications as shown on Map No. I l-M in the area bounded by:

              a line 50.00 feet north of and parallel to West Leiand Avenue, as measured along
              the southwest line of North Lincoln Avenue; North Lincoln Avenue; West Leiand
              Avenue; the public alley next west of and parallel to North Lincoln Avenue

to those of an Cl-1 Neighborhood Commercial District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.

12.    Reason for rezoning the property: To construct a wine bar on the ground floor at 2314
      West Leiand Avenue


13. Describe the proposed use ofthe property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of
    dwelling units; number of parking spaces; approximate square footage ofany commercial
    space; and height ofthe proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC) The subject property measures
    7,797 square feet and is improved with an existing two-story mixed-use building with six
    dwelling units and two loft offices on the upper floor, eight commercial spaces measuring at
    approximately 5.600 square feet on the ground floor, and no parking spaces. The Applicant
    proposes to rezonc the property from a Bl-1 Neighborhood Shopping District to a Cl-1
    Neighborhood Commercial District to construct an approximately 800 square foot wine bar
    located on the ground floor at 2314 West Leiand Avenue. There will be no exterior
    modifications and the height of the building will remain at 28.00 feet.

14. The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units
    and/or a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that
    receive a zoning change vvhich, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area, or,
    for existing Planned Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact sheet or
    visit vvvwv.citvofchicago.org/ARO for more information). Is this project subject to the
    ARO?
